name: YEAR
description: YEAR extracts the year from a date.
tldr: YEAR returns the year component of a date.

parameters.name: serial_number
parameters.description: The date from which to extract the year.

basicExample.explanation: Returns the year from the date "1/15/2026".

advancedExamples.title: Group data by year
advancedExamples.description: Extract years for grouping in pivot tables
advancedExamples.explanation: Converts dates to years for easier grouping.

howItWorks: YEAR extracts the year from a date serial number. Dates in Excel are stored as serial numbers where January 1, 1900 is day 1.

howToSteps.name: Select output cell
howToSteps.text: Choose where the year should appear.

limitations: For month or day, use MONTH or DAY functions.

commonErrors.fix: Ensure the argument is a valid date.

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: YEAR works identically in Google Sheets.

faq.question: What year does Excel start from?
faq.answer: Excel uses the 1900 date system, starting from January 1, 1900.

faq.question: Can YEAR handle dates before 1900?
faq.answer: No, Excel cannot handle dates before January 1, 1900.
